notice: API prices in USD per 1M tokens (input, output) as each catalogue edition showed them. src vendor = read on the vendor's own pricing page; src router = observed on the OpenRouter router. A point is added only when a price, its source or its retirement status changed. ed = the archived edition (next/data/editions/<ed>...). A move from a router price to the vendor's page is a better source, not a price change, so it is not listed under changes.
